summary: Everything emerging derives from its sampled trials - the recent/prior cohort split, the phase and geography rankings, the growth tables and the advisory note - must be assembled in a function that takes those trials and performs no I/O, so the cohort rules can be exercised without a live client.
reason: The analysis sat inline in RunE behind a ctgovFetch, leaving four judgements unreachable by any test: unparsed dates counting as recent, geography spanning both cohorts, a zero baseline yielding NewlyAdded rather than a division, and the ordering of the two note branches. A reprint must preserve the I/O-free helper and those four decisions. Guarded by TestSummarizeEmergingUnparsedDateCountsAsRecent.
validated_outcome: Sending unparsed dates to the prior cohort fails TestSummarizeEmergingUnparsedDateCountsAsRecent (cohorts 2/3, want 3/2), TestSummarizeEmergingNormalizesBeforeTallying (semaglutide recent 2, want 3) and TestSummarizeEmergingNewCategoryIsFlagged (prior 1, want 0), while the generated emerging tests stay green.
